name: Scientific / Technical Visualization
visual_style: Instructionally clear 3D visualization with accurate anatomy or engineering structures and reliable spatial relationships.
camera: Stable educational perspective with controlled zooms and rotations.
lighting: Even technical lighting that separates surfaces and structures.
motion: Slow precise movement highlighting correct mechanisms or biological processes.
consistency: Same model, labels style and color coding across all scenes.
negative_guidance: Inaccurate anatomy or mechanics, decorative clutter, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Clean technical sans-serif with clear labels
video.palette: Neutral background with consistent color-coding per part
video.text_animation: Labels with leader lines; step-by-step build-ups
video.sound: Soft ticks and clicks on labels, gentle transition whooshes
